rules.mandate_id: E01-E10; one or more only if independently separated
rules.source_manifest: immutable source references, original sha, article DOI/version; SOURCE_GAP if unavailable
rules.concepts: two alternatives minimum for OPPO/BodyTwin measurement architecture; one null model
rules.self_falsification: strongest counterexample, positive control, physical DESIGN_ONLY reference, preregistered stop condition
rules.test_evidence: either actual source+binary+command+exit+trace hashes or NOT_RUN/DESIGN_ONLY
rules.uncertainty: units, frames, time sync, independent reference, GUM budget where applicable
rules.limitations: must include things reviewer is unwilling to claim
rules.decision: CONCEPT_CANDIDATE or REJECTED or HOLD; never automatic promotion
